simple.meaning: אוֹצָר (ʼôwtsâr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a depository.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 79 times across Deuteronomy, Joshua, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, and 14 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 28:12. Its contexts include family, family line, kingship, city, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אוֹצָר (H214).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אוֹצָר (ʼôwtsâr) / H214 is traced through Deuteronomy 28:12, Deuteronomy 32:34, Joshua 6:19, Joshua 6:24 as a generated source-based concept entry.
